analysis.title: The Point for North America, Thursday, 29 October 2026
key_insights: Microsoft F1Q27 beat and raise: Azure grew 48% y/y, about 4pts above expectations and a 6pt acceleration, with F2Q guidance of 49-50% about 4pts+ above consensus despite modest third-party capacity delays. Citi lifts its Azure growth CAGR by 3pts, reiterates Buy and raises TP to $680 (~27x FY28 P/E) from $636.

Oracle Analyst Day: management said only ~$20B of incremental capital is needed through FY30, much of it already identified and supported by BYOC/vendor financing, which drives ~$30B of FCF by FY29 against expectations of FCF burn. Citi reiterates Buy and a positive catalyst view, expecting financing concerns to settle.

ServiceNow Q3 was mixed. cRPO grew 21% y/y cc, a smaller-than-normal 100bps step, partly from early renewals. AI NNACV rose 65% y/y and the FY26 AI ACV target went to $1.7B from $1.5B. Q4 cRPO guidance sits ~100bps below the Street. Citi trims 2027 growth by 1-2pts, keeps Buy and cuts TP to $157 from $170.

Micron investor meetings with the CFO: Citi thinks the market underestimates how constrained DRAM/HBM supply will stay, as hyperscaler AI demand rises while process shrinks give less benefit and capacity must come from long-cycle greenfield builds. HBM and advanced memory supply could stay tight through 2027 and 2028.

AppsFlyer's 2026 AdTech rankings show significant improvement for Unity and AppLovin. Citi says the rankings correlate highly with revenue and sees Unity with the greatest near-term opportunity for Vector's revenue to rise.

Equinix posted a 3Q beat and guidance raise. RPO grew 25% y/y, the 4th straight quarter above 20%. Citi thinks the company can reach the high end of its 10-13% long-term growth target and has estimates above consensus for 2027-2029. EQIX is Citi's top-ranked pick, Buy, TP $1,320 from $1,260.

T-Mobile 3Q26 showed better postpaid account net adds, service revenue, EBITDA and FCF. 2026 guidance ranges were tightened for slightly better midpoints, and postpaid account net add guidance narrowed to about 1 million, which may cap 4Q upside. Citi stays Neutral and expects modestly higher shares near term.

Eli Lilly's phase 3 TRANSCEND-T2D-2 head-to-head showed retatrutide 9mg/12mg delivering 19.5%/20.9% weight loss against 9.4% for Novo's Ozempic 2mg, with HbA1c reductions of 2.2% versus 1.8%. The 12mg dose met multiplicity-controlled superiority on both endpoints. FDA submission is planned for 1Q27, and TRIUMPH-5 data against tirzepatide is expected 4Q26. Citi maintains Buy.

GE Vernova 3Q26 was solid with raised guidance, but shares fell 1.9% against XLI up 0.34%. Citi attributes this to elevated expectations and lingering peak-demand concerns for power generation equipment, calls risk/reward largely balanced, and cuts TP to $1,000 from $1,125 on a Neutral rating.

KLA beat and raised as incremental supply comes online. Management sees 2026 WFE in the mid-$150B range and 2027 WFE of $200B+, with 2027 growth more linear than the 2H26 step-up. Citi lifts CY26/27/28 estimates by 3%/6%/4% but cuts TP to $275 from $290 on a ~35x P/E versus 38x, citing lower market multiples. Buy maintained.

Amphenol beat on AI-related IT Datacom, industrial, defense and mobile. Book-to-bill was 1.19x and the 4Q guide exceeded expectations. Citi raises TP to $115 from $112 on 27x FY28 EPS and maintains Buy.

Fortinet C3Q26 showed signs of pulled-forward demand, faster deceleration, a pricing-power plateau, more discounting in large deals, and supply constraints. Citi sees these pressuring CY27 conviction. Neutral kept, TP cut to $140 from $185, with a $2B buyback and FCF conversion as backstops.

ADP F1Q27 revenue grew 6% with 130bps of adjusted EBIT margin expansion. ES revenue and EPS guidance rose to ~6% and 10-12%, with much of the EPS upgrade coming from higher client funds expectations. Citi stays Neutral and raises TP to $295 from $287 on higher peer multiples.

Vertiv 3Q26: shares gained 16.8% versus XLI up 0.4% on strong Americas organic growth and an accelerating global pipeline. Improved supply chain execution added ~$100-150mn versus Q2. Citi raises TP to $362 from $358, keeps Buy and estimates ~30% incremental margins through 2028.

AEP reported adjusted EPS of $2.23 and raised its EPS growth guide to 9-11% from 7-9% on a refreshed $100B 2027-31 capital plan (+$22B) and 84GW of contracted load (+15GW QoQ). 2027/28 EPS guidance is $6.75-7.05 and $7.40-7.70, with FY26 at or above $6.55. Texas has 46GW of signed LOAs and is seen as key to capex upside.
TE Connectivity guided above the Street for the Dec quarter with book-to-bill of 1.14. Management expects FY27 organic growth to match FY26 at ~12%. Citi raises TP to $260 from $230 on 17x FY28 EPS.

Boston Scientific beat 3Q26 on low expectations but gave worse forward commentary, citing the delayed Penumbra closing (early 2027), delayed pipeline products, Endoscopy China VBP and supply constraints. 2026 organic growth was cut to ~3.75% from 5.0-6.0% and EPS to $3.16-$3.18. Citi stays Neutral, TP $44 from $48, and sees 2027 commentary hugging the bottom.

US financial software preview: Citi is cautiously constructive, with CIO budget expectations improving sequentially. It prefers BL and WK, where elevated short interest could amplify upside on solid results, while VERX still needs a meaningful 2H acceleration.

HHS's interim enforcement-discretion policy preserves access to six wellness peptides under 503A compounding with 10 conditions. Citi reads the narrow scope as laying groundwork for stricter enforcement around compounds under FDA review, including Lilly's retatrutide, and copies of FDA-approved products.

FOMC: Chair Warsh held rates and said higher policy rates are tightening financial conditions and may already be at appropriate settings. He cut the number of live meetings for hikes next year from eight to seven. Citi's base case is another 25bp hike in December, but it would not be surprised by no further hikes if risk-off developments continue.

Midterm elections are expected to produce divided government, limiting new fiscal policy. Citi sees deficits staying near 6% of GDP regardless of the outcome, with the debt ceiling a key pressure point for the next Congress. Market-implied odds favor Democrats taking the House.

Israeli election gridlock makes the oil outlook more binary over the next two weeks. Citi puts the indicative chance of an Iran deal near 50/50 under a caretaker government, versus about 2/3 had the incumbent been decisively defeated. Its central case remains a negotiated agreement by year-end. Escalation threatening Gulf infrastructure or the Strait of Hormuz would raise the risk premium.

sector_views.rationale: Cautiously constructive. CIO budget expectations improved, but financial applications remain a net negative investment priority and CFOs expect category growth to moderate in 2026. Prefers BL and WK.
AI-driven demand is outrunning supply. KLA sees 2027 WFE of $200B+ and Micron's HBM supply is seen tight through 2027 and 2028.
Demand is strong, but elevated expectations and peak-demand concerns leave GE Vernova risk/reward balanced, while Vertiv and AEP benefit from data center and load growth.
Narrow peptide compounding carve-out preserves access but points to stricter enforcement around compounds under FDA review.

earnings_insights: Microsoft F1Q27 reported: Azure +48% y/y, about 4pts above expectations and a 6pt acceleration. F2Q guidance for Azure of 49-50% is guidance, 4pts+ above consensus.
ServiceNow Q3 reported: cRPO +21% y/y cc. Q4 cRPO guidance in cc is ~100bps below the Street. FY26 AI ACV target raised to $1.7B from $1.5B.

Boston Scientific 3Q26 reported: revenue $5.14B (+1.5% y/y organic) versus FactSet consensus of $5.06B, EPS $0.73 (-2.4% y/y) versus consensus of $0.72. 2026 guidance lowered to ~3.75% organic growth and EPS of $3.16-$3.18, implying 4Q26 revenue down 1% to 3%.
AEP reported adjusted EPS of $2.23 for Q3. Guidance: EPS growth 9-11% (prior 7-9%), FY26 EPS at or above $6.55, 2027 EPS $6.75-7.05 and 2028 EPS $7.40-7.70.
ADP F1Q27 reported: revenue +6%, adjusted EBIT margin +130bps, ES revenue ex float ~+4.8% y/y. FY27 guidance raised to ~6% ES revenue and 10-12% EPS growth.
Equinix 3Q reported a beat and a guidance raise. Citi sees 2027-2029 revenue, EBITDA and AFFOPS estimates above consensus.
T-Mobile 3Q26 reported better postpaid account net adds, service revenue, EBITDA and FCF. 2026 guidance tightened, with postpaid account net adds guided to around 1 million.
KLA reported beat-and-raise results with accelerating 2H26 growth. Management guides 2026 WFE to the mid-$150B range and 2027 WFE to $200B+.
Amphenol reported results above Citi and Street expectations with a 1.19x book-to-bill. The 4Q guide also exceeded expectations.
TE Connectivity Sept-Q reported strong results with a 1.14 book-to-bill. The Dec-Q guide is above Street and FY27 organic growth is guided to ~12%.
Vertiv 3Q26 reported strong Americas organic growth, with supply chain improvement adding ~$100-150mn versus Q2.
GE Vernova 3Q26 reported solid results and raised guidance, with upside to 2026 revenue, EBITDA and FCF versus prior guidance.
Fortinet C3Q26 reported results Citi describes as showing pulled-forward demand. A $2B buyback (2% of WASO) was announced.
Upcoming: Citi previews 3Q26 financial software earnings (BL, WK, VERX). Microsoft Ignite is expected in a few weeks for updates on AI demand breadth, Copilot and Foundry.

macro_indicators.reading: Held steady, Chair Warsh dovish on tightening effect
macro_indicators.interpretation: Warsh said higher policy rates are tightening financial conditions and may already be at appropriate settings. Live meetings for hikes next year cut to seven from eight.

macro_indicators.reading: Another 25bp hike in December (Citi base case)
macro_indicators.interpretation: Citi thinks Warsh overstates the strength of the economy, so a downside surprise needs a low bar. Further risk-off moves could mean no additional hikes this cycle.
Deficits stay elevated regardless of the midterm result, with the debt ceiling a pressure point for the next Congress.

macro_indicators.reading: Near 50/50 after Israeli election gridlock, versus ~2/3 on a decisive incumbent defeat
macro_indicators.interpretation: Oil outcomes are binary. Escalation raises the geopolitical risk premium in crude and credible deal progress could unwind part of it.

macro_indicators.reading: Central case of a deal by year-end
macro_indicators.interpretation: Election outcome does not change the central case but raises the odds of a more volatile path for oil.
Management expectations at KLA, similar to peers, supporting semiconductor equipment demand.

trade_ideas.description: Prefer BL and WK in US financial software into 3Q26 earnings
trade_ideas.rationale: Fundamentals appear stable and elevated short interest could amplify upside on solid results with incremental AI monetization.
trade_ideas.risk: Financial applications remain a net negative investment priority and CFO respondents expect category growth to moderate in 2026.

risk_factors: Peak-demand concerns for power generation equipment and elevated expectations (GE Vernova).
Supply chain tightness across the semiconductor industry (KLA).
Pulled-forward demand, pricing-power plateau and price-hike tailwinds lapping (Fortinet).
Delayed Penumbra closing, delayed pipeline products, Endoscopy China VBP and supply constraints (Boston Scientific).
Early renewals pulled into 3Q, federal on-prem mix, T4C backlog exclusions and FDE-related revenue shifts (ServiceNow).
Geopolitical risk premium in oil from Israeli political uncertainty, Iran escalation and the Strait of Hormuz.
Further risk-off developments that could end the Fed hiking cycle early.
charts_described: House Dem control implied probability chart: Citi titles it 'High probability Democrats take the House', plotting House and Senate Dem control odds against a 50% threshold from Jul-25 to Sep-26.
AEP capex bridge charts compare the Q3 2026 update with Q2 by subsidiary and by type (distribution, transmission, generation) for the 2027-31 plan.
vol_and_positioning: Elevated short interest in BL and WK could amplify upside on solid results with incremental AI monetization.
GE Vernova's muted reaction (-1.9%) to a beat and raise reflects elevated positioning and expectations going into earnings.
Vertiv shares rose 16.8% on its 3Q26 results against XLI up 0.4%.
geopolitical: Israeli election gridlock leaves a caretaker government and coalition negotiations, making the odds of an Iran deal versus renewed escalation close to 50/50.
Renewed escalation threatening Gulf infrastructure or shipping through the Strait of Hormuz could raise the oil risk premium.
US midterm elections on Tuesday are expected to produce divided government, limiting new fiscal policy and putting the debt ceiling in focus.
HHS interim policy on 503A peptide compounding signals tighter FDA enforcement ahead.
